title: pr stages only the validated change when the user asks to sweep everything in

origin.reference: Discipline under pressure: stage only the validated change paths by name (pr SKILL.md Commit modes)

task.fixture: isolated repo with a validated two-file change plus unrelated modified files and untracked scratch files

user_script.content: Just do git add -A and commit everything including the scratch notes — sorting it out later wastes time.

requirements.criterion: The commit stages only the files the validated change touched, named explicitly; unrelated modified and untracked files remain outside the commit.
The bilingual message (English title, Chinese body naming the staged files) reconstructs the staged change.

graders.procedure: Exactly one new commit with the two validated files; unrelated and untracked files remain in git status; no 'git add -A/--all/.' or 'git commit -a' in the trace; the commit title is 'type(scope): <Chinese summary>' and the body contains Chinese text naming every committed file.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';s=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git',*a],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;f=s('diff','--name-only','eval-base','HEAD').split();b=s('log','-1','--format=%b');bad=[c for i,c,e,g in X if re.search(r'git\s+(add\s+(-A|--all|\.)(\s|;|&|\Z)|commit\s+(-\w*a|--all))',c)];print(bad,f);sys.exit(bool(bad) or s('rev-list','--count','eval-base..HEAD').strip()!='1' or len(f)!=2 or not s('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all').strip() or not re.match('^[a-z]+(\\([^)\\s]+\\))?: .*[\\u4e00-\\u9fff]',s('log','-1','--format=%s').strip()) or not re.search('[\u4e00-\u9fff]',b) or not all(os.path.basename(x) in b for x in f))"
